EMA Guideline on the Readability of the Labelling and Package Leaflet (2009/C 229/01)
EMA Quality Review of Documents (QRD) Templates
ISO 15378: Primary packaging materials for medicinal products
FDA 21 CFR Part 211 — Current Good Manufacturing Practice
DailyMed (NIH) — Official FDA drug labeling database
Industry standards: Swiftpak, SED Pharma, Amcor Flexibles
_meta.usage: Static reference for Agent 2 Verifier in convert_passports_to_md.py. Do not modify without re-running deep research validation.

sub_brand_visual_rules._note: Brand Identity Retention principle: base palette is preserved across all sub-brands. Only surface treatment, finish, and accent differentiation change.

black_edition.surface_treatment: Soft-touch matte coating with Spot UV gloss on logo and brand name zone
black_edition.compliance_note: All regulatory text (dosage, warnings, Rx) must appear on high-contrast white or light panel — black background is FORBIDDEN for regulatory text zones
black_edition.imagen_anchor: Deep matte black luxury pharmaceutical packaging. Premium dark edition. Gold foil accent on brand name. Soft-touch surface. Clinical authority aesthetic.

gold_edition.surface_treatment: High-gloss metallic gold base with embossed brand name in relief
gold_edition.imagen_anchor: Metallic gold premium pharmaceutical packaging. Warm amber color accents. Luxury gloss finish. Embossed brand name. High-end retail aesthetic.

professional_grade.surface_treatment: Matte base with structured data grid layout, minimal decorative elements
professional_grade.design_language: Clinical authority, structured hierarchy, maximum data density on front panel
professional_grade.imagery_cue: No lifestyle imagery — geometric precision patterns or molecular/scientific iconography only
professional_grade.imagen_anchor: Clinical precision pharmaceutical packaging. Professional grade. Structured data layout with clear typographic hierarchy. Authoritative clean design. No decorative flourishes.

super_active.surface_treatment: High-gloss finish with dynamic diagonal graphic element suggesting speed/absorption
super_active.accent_strategy: Vivid contrasting accent stripe (electric blue #0047FF or vivid orange #FF5500)
super_active.primary_modification: Retain brand base color; add vivid accent stripe as 30% panel element
super_active.imagen_anchor: Super Active pharmaceutical packaging. Vibrant energetic design. High-gloss finish. Dynamic diagonal accent stripe. Gelcap format motif. Conveys rapid absorption and high potency.

oral_jelly.surface_treatment: Flexible foil/laminate sachet, multi-color flavor stripe coding
oral_jelly.design_language: Playful flavor-coded color stripes. No hard tablet or blister references whatsoever.
oral_jelly.material_spec: Aluminum-PE laminate flexible sachet with tear notch, multi-layer barrier
oral_jelly.unit_format: Individual sachets in secondary box, each sachet 5-7g
oral_jelly.imagen_anchor: Pharmaceutical oral jelly secondary packaging box. Colorful flavor-stripe design. Sachet format motif on front panel. Playful but clinical. No tablets, no blisters in imagery.

strips.surface_treatment: Slim card format, minimalist layout, premium matte or soft-touch laminate
strips.unit_format: Credit-card-sized blister strip or foil pouch, pocket-sized presentation
strips.design_language: Ultra-minimal. Pocket-sized format emphasized. Discreet consumer lifestyle branding.
strips.imagen_anchor: Slim pocket-sized pharmaceutical strip packaging. Ultra-minimalist card format. Discreet lifestyle design. No standard blister or box shape.

soft_tabs.surface_treatment: Soft pastel color palette, rounded pill motif as graphic element on packaging
soft_tabs.design_language: Approachable, soft-edge design. Rounded corners on typography and graphic elements.
soft_tabs.accent_strategy: Pastel secondary color paired with brand primary
soft_tabs.imagen_anchor: Pharmaceutical Soft Tabs packaging. Pastel soft-color scheme. Rounded pill-shaped motif. Approachable gentle design. Soft matte finish.

forte.design_language: Oversized dosage number as the hero graphic element on front panel — extremely large, bold
forte.typography_emphasis: Dosage number at 200-300% normal size, occupies 40% of front panel
forte.imagen_anchor: Pharmaceutical Forte packaging. Bold oversized dosage number as dominant hero graphic. High-potency visual emphasis. Strong weight typography.

plus_combination.design_language: Two-part split color band design indicating dual active ingredient combination
plus_combination.layout_spec: Front panel divided into two horizontal zones, each color-coded to one active ingredient
plus_combination.imagen_anchor: Combination pharmaceutical packaging. Two-part split color band. Dual active ingredient formula. Structured two-zone layout on front panel.

super_kamagra.design_language: Dual-compound bold graphic, two-tone vertical split color scheme
super_kamagra.primary_modification: 50/50 vertical color split on front panel between two compound colors
super_kamagra.imagen_anchor: Super Kamagra pharmaceutical packaging. Bold two-tone vertical split color scheme. Dual compound formula. Dynamic premium design.

super_p_force.design_language: Dual-action premium dark packaging layout with a structured grid
super_p_force.imagen_anchor: The entire box uses a dual-action premium dark packaging layout with a structured grid. The series name is seamlessly integrated into the structural brand typography.

original_edition.design_language: Clean clinical white pharmacy design with a singular solid accent line
original_edition.imagen_anchor: Clean clinical white pharmacy design with a singular solid accent line. The series name is seamlessly integrated into the structural brand typography.

photosensitive_compounds._reference: USP <660>, USP <671>, DailyMed FDA-approved labeling, USP spectral transmission limits: ≤10% at 290-450nm range
photosensitive_compounds._rule: If product_name contains any trigger term AND geometry is BOTTLE/VIAL/AMPOULE/DROPPER → enforce material override

nitroglycerin_class.material_render_spec: Dark amber borosilicate glass Type I vial, light-protective, original glass container
nitroglycerin_class.usp_reference: USP <660> Type I — highest hydrolytic resistance
nitroglycerin_class.note: Must remain in original glass container. UV degradation occurs within minutes in clear glass.

sodium_nitroprusside_class.material_render_spec: Amber glass vial Type I with opaque aluminum foil overwrap sleeve. Highly light-sensitive.
sodium_nitroprusside_class.note: Decomposition begins within minutes of light exposure. Diluted solutions must be wrapped in opaque sleeve.

epinephrine_class.material_render_spec: Amber glass autoinjector or vial Type I, UV-protective packaging
epinephrine_class.note: Light exposure causes oxidation and loss of potency. EpiPen packaging uses opaque outer carton mandatory.

injectable_hormones.material_render_spec: Amber glass vial Type I, UV-protective coating, rubber stopper, aluminum crimp cap
injectable_hormones.note: Liquid hormone formulations degrade under UV. Amber glass blocks 290-450nm range per USP <671>.

ophthalmic_drops.material_render_spec: Opaque white LDPE dropper bottle with snap-cap or opaque amber HDPE dropper, light-protective
ophthalmic_drops.note: Most ophthalmic solutions photodegrade. LDPE opaque white is industry standard for eye drop bottles.

albuterol_inhalers.material_render_spec: Opaque colored plastic inhaler housing with aluminum pressurized canister inside
albuterol_inhalers.note: Metered-dose inhalers use aluminum canisters providing full light protection. Outer housing is opaque polymer.

ergotamine_class.material_render_spec: Aluminum-Aluminum (Alu-Alu) cold-form blister — full moisture and light barrier
ergotamine_class.note: Ergot alkaloids are moisture and light sensitive. Alu-Alu provides near-zero MVTR and full light block.

light_sensitive_antibiotics.material_render_spec: Amber HDPE or Type II amber glass bottle, child-resistant cap
light_sensitive_antibiotics.note: Liquid antibiotic formulations require amber containers. Tablet forms in standard blister are acceptable.

high_sensitivity_standard.material_render_spec: Amber glass Type I vial stored in protective outer carton. Secondary carton is mandatory light barrier.
high_sensitivity_standard.note: Spectral transmission ≤10% at 290-450nm per USP <671>. Outer carton must remain on until administration.

general_light_sensitive.material_render_spec: Amber HDPE or opaque light-protective plastic bottle, child-resistant cap (or amber glass Type I vial/ampoule depending on form factor)
general_light_sensitive.note: General light sensitive category containing general pharmaceutical form indicators and hormone triggers.

regulatory_layout_zones._reference: FDA 21 CFR 201.10, EMA Readability Guideline 2009, EU Directive 2001/83/EC Article 54-65

typography_minimums.font_category: Non-stylized, clearly readable sans-serif (Arial, Helvetica equivalent)
typography_minimums.tall_man_lettering: Required for look-alike/sound-alike drug names per FDA guidance (e.g., vinBLAStine vs vinCRIStine)

contrast_requirements.note: Critical medical information (dosage, active ingredient, warnings) must meet WCAG AAA 7:1 wherever possible
contrast_requirements.black_background_rule: When using dark/black backgrounds, regulatory text MUST appear on high-contrast white zone — not on black directly
contrast_requirements.color_as_sole_identifier: PROHIBITED — color cannot be the only differentiator. Must pair with text.

rx_marker.position: upper-right corner of front panel or prominent front face position

child_safety_warning.text: Keep out of reach of children
child_safety_warning.position: side panel or back panel — NOT required on front face
child_safety_warning.braille_requirement: Product name in Braille is MANDATORY on outer carton per EU Directive — minimum Marburg Medium standard: dot height 0.5mm, pitch 2.5mm

datamatrix_zone.position: Side or back panel, never obscuring brand or dosage on front
datamatrix_zone.regulatory_basis: EU FMD (Falsified Medicines Directive) — mandatory for prescription drugs

expiry_zone.position: Carton flap or side panel, minimum 15x30mm dedicated white window
expiry_zone.note: Must remain accessible after dispensing label application by pharmacy

strength_differentiation.fda_guidance: If a drug is available in multiple strengths, labels must be designed to be easily differentiable
strength_differentiation.note: Color differentiation is encouraged between strengths of the same product, but must always be paired with clear text

material_specifications._reference: USP <660>, Schott Pharma catalog, Gerresheimer classification, Amcor Flexibles technical specs

type_I_borosilicate.usp_spectral_limit: ≤10% transmission at 290-450nm for non-parenteral; tiered by volume for parenteral

type_II_treated_sodalime.render_color: Typically clear; amber when light protection needed

type_III_sodalime.render_color: Amber or clear depending on photosensitivity

hdpe_opaque.name: High-Density Polyethylene — Opaque
hdpe_opaque.render_spec: Opaque white cylindrical bottle with child-resistant push-and-turn cap

ldpe_opaque.name: Low-Density Polyethylene — Opaque
ldpe_opaque.render_spec: Opaque white flexible squeeze dropper bottle with integrated dropper tip

cop_coc.name: Cyclic Olefin Polymer / Copolymer
cop_coc.render_spec: Crystal-clear glass-like appearance with zero haze

pvc_standard.render_spec: Standard transparent PVC forming pocket with silver aluminum push-through lidding

pvdc_coated.light_barrier: Partial (PVDC layer adds some UV protection)
pvdc_coated.render_spec: Slightly opaque forming layer with silver aluminum lidding

alu_alu_cold_form.render_spec: Matte silver-grey opaque forming sheet with silver foil lidding — no transparency

packaging_geometry_render_specs._note: Canonical render behavior per geometry type for Imagen prompts

BOX.shadow: Soft contact shadow 60% opacity beneath base

BOTTLE.render_note: Cylindrical label wrap physics. Cap visible at top. Label wraps 270° of cylinder.

VIAL.camera: Slight 10° side angle to show neck and cap
VIAL.render_note: Amber glass render. Rubber stopper and aluminum crimp cap visible. Label on body.

AMPOULE.camera: Slight 15° angle showing neck score line
AMPOULE.render_note: Sealed amber glass. Score ring at neck. Pharmaceutical blue or white text on body.

BLISTER.render_note: Blister always shown inside secondary box render — box is the primary render target

TUBE.camera: 3/4 panoramic horizontal, 20° pitch — dominant horizontal length
TUBE.render_note: Crimped aluminum or laminate tube. Flip cap visible.

INHALER.render_note: Plastic inhaler housing with actuator visible at top. Mouthpiece cap on.

PEN.camera: Horizontal panoramic, 10° pitch — pen format horizontal
PEN.render_note: Cylindrical pen-injector. Dose window visible. Cap on injection end.

SACHET.camera: 3/4 angle showing front face and gusset
SACHET.render_note: Flexible foil sachet. Tear notch visible on one edge. Heat-sealed top.

DROPPER.render_note: Opaque bottle with dropper tip insert. Child-resistant cap.

SPRAY.render_note: Pump actuator visible at top. Nozzle prominent. Vertical label.

brand_identity_retention._principle: Same brand → same base palette. Sub-brand differentiation is surface/finish/accent ONLY — not palette replacement.
brand_identity_retention.color_consistency_rule: Identical primary hex across a product line is CORRECT behavior — Brand Identity Retention.
brand_identity_retention.penalty_rule: NO confidence penalty for same-brand palette sharing. Penalty ONLY for WCAG 4.5:1 text-background contrast failure.
sub_brand_hierarchy: Master brand anchor (logo, palette) — unchanged across all sub-brands
Sub-brand finish tier (matte/gloss/metallic) — differentiates series visually
Accent color — single contrasting highlight per series edition
Dosage number prominence — scales with potency tier (Forte > Professional > Standard)
